facts.business: Crest Ventures Limited operates in financial and related services (wholesale debt broking, forex, derivatives, mutual funds, portfolio management), real estate and related activities (residential/commercial development, project fees, license fees), and investing and credit activities (investments in subsidiaries/associates/JVs and advancing loans).

guidance_or_targets.statement: Expect Non-SLR business to keep gaining market share
Expect Crest Oaks and Crest Uno, Bandra to add to revenue
Expect Crest 4 Pali Hill, Crest Saidale and Crest Golfshire to contribute

auditor.name: N.A. Shah Associates LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on recoverability of deposits aggregating Rs 15,529.75 lakhs with certain counter parties based on mortgage charge, JV agreement, valuation report and pledge of shares (Note 9.1). Report not modified.

key_risks: Escalation in West Asia, higher crude oil prices, weaker rupee adding pressure to markets
Significant management judgement in Expected Credit Loss (ECL) estimation under Ind AS 109
Recoverability of carrying value of inventory, project advances and deposits for joint development dependent on dynamic management estimates (project plan, FSI rules, etc.)
Concentration of advances and exposures: 100% to twenty largest borrowers/customers
facts.related_party_note: Remuneration of Directors and Transactions with non-executive directors (Directors sitting fees): Rs 20.00 lakhs (current year), Rs 11.00 lakhs (previous year). Scheme of Arrangement approved for demerger of Demerged Undertaking into Crest Capital and Investment Limited.
